title: Car wash opening on an existing leased lot, no construction — Carolina, industrial zone X
description: We are opening a hand car wash on an existing leased lot with a covered bay in Carolina. The bay and drains are already built, so there is no construction. Four employees.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN; employees also trigger RULE_0620.
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI).
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal).
RULE_0007: a physical commercial premises -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009).

mustNotInclude.rationale: No construction stated: RULE_0643/0644 need a construction / renovation project type.
FEMA zone X: RULE_0706 needs location.flood_zone.sfha.
Pin outside the coastal zone: RULE_0708 needs location.czm.
Commercial use on industrial urban land, no change of use: no consulta trigger.

ordering.rationale: KB documents.json: DOC_PATENTE_MUNICIPAL depends on DOC_PERMISO_UNICO.

notes: Added 2026-10-05 by the scenario loop: first car-wash scenario and first Carolina scenario. Car-wash wastewater (RULE_0666/0667, AAA pretreatment) is a heuristic municipality-flag rule and is deliberately not asserted here.
